scenario: One GameMode.Server and two independent GameMode.Client runners in one headless Unity Editor process; real Photon session, separate physics scenes; not a browser/phone test.
passedChecks: Real Photon room: dedicated server plus two clients, no server player slot, isolated peer physics scenes.
Server owns authoritative heroes; clients own only their own input.
Client input moves the server hero; other client converges to the same position.
Server creates projectile and applies hit; both clients receive authoritative damage.
Leaving client removes its hero on server and remaining client.
New client can join the same surviving server session after disconnect (fresh join, not authenticated resume).
limitations: One headless Unity Editor process, three independent network peers; not separate device processes.
This network scenario does not test WebGL or a phone; separate WebGL offline checks were recorded later in fusion-webgl-qualification.json.
Fresh join after disconnect, not authenticated resume or NFT lease recovery.
Demo heroes only; Genesis admission, class abilities and CHOG purchases not wired.
No 100 CCU load test or proof of plan activation.
